paragraphs: Abba bar Machsya, father of Rabbi Yitzchak: Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 2:2. Rava bar Machsya: Shabbat 10b; in Taanit 12b the reading is Rabbah. Hyman suggests that he may be Abba, noting that Rabbah and Rava bore the name Abba.

notes.text: The suggested connection with Abba is Hyman’s conjecture; the listed forms remain distinct textual readings.
